source.name: Alliance of Genome Resources combined orthology export
source.license_assessment: FMS per-file metadata does not expose a license. The official Alliance open-data README states most Alliance data is CC0 1.0 and some datasets may be CC-BY 4.0; this export's specific license was not inferred. The official terms page and README are saved in raw/license/.

snapshot.revision_note: FMS suffixes are revision identifiers. This snapshot uses the single valid datafile associated with FMS catalogue release 9.2.0 (ID 339902); its TSV preamble self-identifies Alliance Database Version 9.0.0 and file generation time 2026-04-05T03:33Z. Older suffixes were not concatenated.

crosswalk.method: WormBase WB:WBGene IDs stripped to WBGene and validated in genes(species='worm', id=?). Mouse/human IDs mapped only by exact aliases(species=?, token=?, entity_type='gene').
crosswalk.unresolved: No symbol-based guessing; unresolved Alliance IDs and symbols are retained.

method_universe_note: Per-species-pair methods are reconstructed from all same-version export rows, checked against constant OutOfAlgorithms and an actual full-support witness. Not the full DIOPT method universe.
absent_method_semantics: not listed as supporting this pair; not an explicit negative call
absent_pair_semantics: unknown; not represented as a negative call

coverage.representation: Observed Alliance combined orthology rows. Each pair uses its original Gene1-to-Gene2 row when present; reverse fallback is used only if direct orientation is absent. All original directional observations are retained separately.
coverage.alliance_diopt_scope: Alliance orthology is based on a subset of DIOPT data; not the full DIOPT universe.

summary.method_universe_note: Per-species-pair methods are reconstructed from all same-version export rows, checked against constant OutOfAlgorithms and an actual full-support witness. Not the full DIOPT method universe.
summary.absent_pair_semantics: unknown; no negative result is inferred
summary.absent_method_semantics: not listed as supporting; no explicit negative result is inferred

crosscheck.scope: One public wht-1 query only; crosscheck rows never fill or alter the Alliance export.

method_catalogue_source.absent_cell_semantics: not listed as supporting; not an explicit negative call
